steps: Require the job to start from a clean branch aligned with origin/main and remain the sole prospective writer.
Verify its additive tranche, evidence, manifest and global run-integration audit bytes independently.
Keep all same-date collisions blocked; do not select or aggregate intraday values without separate approval.
Continue historical acquisition only with archives or dated editorial evidence that cannot compete with the canonical prospective collector; prioritise the 2023-2024 exact-MPN UK gap.
Keep weekly as an acquisition preference and monthly/quarterly as honest fallbacks; do not interpolate, connect or aggregate sparse points without approval.
Do not approve methodology, sources, references, baskets, production actions or publication.
